scope: split empirical-conformal physical GLRT, stratified by same-UAV excess-peak count and calibrated for separated N=6 frames

separated.scope: paired unknown-N path-to-target association comparison on the same synthetic imperfect candidates; not an OTFS front-end comparison

metric_definitions.position_set_exact_15m: correct cardinality and one-to-one position matches within 15 m
metric_definitions.position_velocity_state_exact: position-set exact plus every matched velocity error <= 1 m/s
metric_definitions.gospa_15m_p2: GOSPA with p=2, cutoff=15 m, alpha=2
metric_definitions.path_association_precision: correctly grouped true paths / all grouped candidates
metric_definitions.path_association_recall: correctly grouped true paths / all retained true path candidates
